info.title: atlas-cli
info.description: A .NET global tool for interacting with Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket Cloud — manage work items, projects, sprints, spaces, pages, and pipelines from the command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Atlassian CLI - interact with Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket
